lean_measurement: head-to-torso world geometry, positive toward finish; after first 5 game seconds
contact_measurement: foot flags and low-torso proxy; no knee contact flag
initial_condition_note: All environments use the same original native initial state; stochastic episodes differ in sampled actions, not independently varied initial conditions.
episode_return_comparison_note: Returns from different reward profiles have different definitions; compare native success, final time and posture metrics instead.
gait_measurement: torso height proxy, not mass-weighted COM; alternating foot contacts after >=3 airborne frames and >=2 contact frames, >=0.15 seconds apart
